races.display_title: Wee Brian Reilly Memorial EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: CELTIC STORM is shaping up well, appreciating the increase in trip and improving on his debut form when posting a good third at Kempton (1m) 16 days ago.
